summary: Senior Manager, Analytics and Insights profile with ~7 years producing performance metrics, automated reporting, and decision-ready insights for risk and governance stakeholders. At Moody's Analytics, holds delegated sign-off on analytical outputs for institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement), re-engineered manual spreadsheet reporting into auditable Python analytics pipelines, and cut cycle time an estimated 30-40% via automated validation and anomaly-detection scaffolding. CFA charterholder with dual MSc degrees; regular presenter to executive and committee audiences.
core_skills: Agentic AI Workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) - automated validation scaffolding & anomaly detection in code/analytics pipelines; Git / CI-CD

sections.heading: Reporting, Portfolio Insights & Executive Communication
bullets: Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities - translating quantitative results into committee-ready narratives for executive and business-line audiences.
Served as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders on findings requiring management attention.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level detail into portfolio-level metrics, giving stakeholders both headline and more granular views of the same book.

sections.heading: Automated Reporting, Data Pipelines & Analytics Tooling
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation - reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, providing forward-looking visibility used in executive contingency planning.

sections.heading: Quality Assurance, Governance & Oversight
bullets: Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing methodology and assumptions before production release.
Contributed as a member of the model governance committee to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and performance assessment of client-delivered analytics.
Challenged and escalated outputs that were mathematically consistent but economically indefensible, holding release until assumptions and methodology could be independently justified.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms adopting the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms.
Acted as technical liaison between client teams and product owners - scoping business requirements into development requests and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Contributed to migrating all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso environment to PFaroe PM.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients.

Contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes while coordinating actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery and implementation materials.
Delivered analytical studies for Canadian and international pension funds - quantifying funding-ratio, duration-mismatch, and long-horizon exposures under base-case and stressed conditions.
Built and interpreted stochastic scenario generators and performed risk decomposition and attribution (contribution-to-risk, risk budgeting) to isolate the drivers behind headline results.
Presented study findings and recommendations on-site to investment committees at pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
